To start Docker Desktop or Docker Engine on Windows, you typically use services or Docker Desktop UI. There's also `docker-machine start` for Docker Machine. Or you can start the Docker service via `net start com.docker.service`. Or if using Docker Desktop, you might need to launch Docker Desktop app.
